-- b/main/go.mod --
module example.com/bmain

go 1.27

-- b/main/bmain.go --
package bmain

import "os/exec"

func Spawn() error {
	run := func() error { return exec.Command("true").Run() }
	return run()
}

-- b/main/bmain_test.go --
package bmain

import "testing"

func TestSpawn(t *testing.T) {
	if testing.Short() {
		t.Skip("reachability only")
	}
	t.Run("spawn", func(t *testing.T) { _ = Spawn() })
}

-- b/main/runner/runner.go --
package runner

import (
	"net"
	"os/exec"
)

func Run() error { return exec.Command("true").Run() }

func Dial() error {
	c, err := net.Dial("tcp", "127.0.0.1:1")
	if c != nil {
		c.Close()
	}
	return err
}

-- b/main/runner/runner_test.go --
package runner

import "testing"

func TestRun(t *testing.T) {
	if testing.Short() {
		t.Skip("reachability only")
	}
	_ = Run()
	_ = Dial()
}

-- c/main/go.mod --
module example.com/cmain

go 1.27

-- c/main/run/run.lgo --
package run

import "os/exec"

func Run() error {
	err := exec.Command("true").Run()
	return err
}

-- c/main/run/run_test.lgo --
package run

import "testing"

func TestRun(t *testing.T) {
	if testing.Short() {
		t.Skip("reachability only")
	}
	if err := Run(); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
}

-- d/dep/go.mod --
module example.com/ddep

go 1.27

-- d/dep/dep.go --
package dep

import "os/exec"

//go:noinline
func Init() {
	cmd := exec.Command("echo", "hi")
	_ = cmd.Run()
}

-- e/dep/go.mod --
module example.com/edep

go 1.27

-- e/dep/dep.go --
package edep

import "os/exec"

type Runner struct{}

//go:noinline
func (Runner) Run() {
	f := func() { _ = exec.Command("echo", "hi").Run() }
	f()
}

module example.com/hdep

go 1.27

-- h/dep/dep.go --
package dep

import "os/exec"

//go:noinline
func Watch() {
	_ = exec.Command("echo", "hi").Run()
}

-- h/dep/dep_test.go --
package dep_test

import (
	"os/exec"
	"testing"
)

func TestWatch(t *testing.T) {
	if testing.Short() {
		t.Skip("reachability only")
	}
	_ = exec.Command("echo", "hi").Run()
}
